mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend (3-month change) is negative but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts and low federal funds rates indicates strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST growth * FEDFUNDS) is positive but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (annualized quarterly growth above 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth (annualized) is above 2.0%, 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls over three months indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS trend (3-month change) is positive but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 98.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 98.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with low housing starts indicates a weak labor market and reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * HOUST) is high but 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expectations of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 225.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.
